rally_academy_retry.title: Rally Academy: Retry
rally_academy_retry.desc: Return immediately to the marked training start.

rally_academy_menu.title: Rally Academy: Open menu
rally_academy_menu.desc: Open or close the Rally Academy screen (pauses the game while open).

rally_academy_save_spot.title: Rally Academy: Save spot
rally_academy_save_spot.desc: Bookmark where you are as a possible drill venue (room, slope, road, surfaces).

rally_academy_pass.title: Rally Academy: Score pass
rally_academy_pass.desc: Record a passing attempt after assessing the manoeuvre.

rally_academy_miss.title: Rally Academy: Score miss
rally_academy_miss.desc: Record an unsuccessful attempt after assessing the manoeuvre.

rally_academy_go_to_drill.title: Rally Academy: Go to drill
rally_academy_go_to_drill.desc: Load the selected drill's map and car, and place you at its start.

rally_academy_next_drill.title: Rally Academy: Next drill
rally_academy_next_drill.desc: Select the next drill in curriculum order.

rally_academy_previous_drill.title: Rally Academy: Previous drill
rally_academy_previous_drill.desc: Select the previous drill in curriculum order.

rally_academy_mark_start.title: Rally Academy: Mark start / Move course here
rally_academy_mark_start.desc: Save where you are as the drill's start (a course drill lays its course out from here).

rally_academy_venue_start.title: Rally Academy: Use venue start
rally_academy_venue_start.desc: Course drills: forget your marked start and lay the course out at the venue again.

rally_academy_mark_finish.title: Rally Academy: Mark finish / stop zone / stop line
rally_academy_mark_finish.desc: Mark the drill's finish, stop zone or stop line where you are.

rally_academy_add_gate.title: Rally Academy: Add gate
rally_academy_add_gate.desc: Mark the next gate across the road where you are.

rally_academy_clear_gates.title: Rally Academy: Clear gates
rally_academy_clear_gates.desc: Remove the gates you marked for this drill.

rally_academy_auto_retry.title: Rally Academy: Auto-retry on/off
rally_academy_auto_retry.desc: Start the next attempt automatically after a graded run, or not.

rally_academy_show_line.title: Rally Academy: Racing line on/off
rally_academy_show_line.desc: Show the racing line on the road: red to brake, yellow to hold, green to accelerate.
